lessonTitle: 47. Constructions on drawings: traces and auxiliary planes
lessonTitleEnglish: Constructions on drawings: traces and auxiliary planes
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 10 mathematics textbooks (advanced stream)

stages.headline: Building a section: two points of the cutting plane on one face give a side of the section; parallel faces are cut along parallel lines.
stages.headlineEnglish: Building a section: two points of the cutting plane on one face give a side of the section; parallel faces are cut along parallel lines.

stages.headline: The method of traces: find where the cutting plane meets the base plane — e.g. line KL meets the extension of AB at X, a point of the trace.
stages.headlineEnglish: The method of traces: find where the cutting plane meets the base plane — e.g. line KL meets the extension of AB at X, a point of the trace.

stages.headline: Example: the section of a cube through A, C and B₁ is an equilateral triangle, because its sides are face diagonals.
stages.headlineEnglish: Example: the section of a cube through A, C and B₁ is an equilateral triangle, because its sides are face diagonals.

stages.headline: What is the line where the cutting plane meets the plane of a face called?
stages.headlineEnglish: What is the line where the cutting plane meets the plane of a face called?

optionsQuiz.feedbackIncorrect: 🤔 Not quite. The correct answer is {correctText}.

stages.headline: A cube has edge 2. Find the perimeter of the section through A, C, B₁.
stages.headlineEnglish: A cube has edge 2. Find the perimeter of the section through A, C, B₁.
stages.problemText: A cube has edge 2. Find the perimeter of the section through A, C, B₁.
stages.solutionSteps: 1. Each side is a face diagonal, 2√2. 2. P = 6√2.
stages.solutionStepsEnglish: 1. Each side is a face diagonal, 2√2. 2. P = 6√2.

stages.headline: A cube is cut by the plane through the midpoints of AA₁, BB₁ and the vertex C₁. What is the section?
stages.headlineEnglish: A cube is cut by the plane through the midpoints of AA₁, BB₁ and the vertex C₁. What is the section?
stages.problemText: A cube is cut by the plane through the midpoints of AA₁, BB₁ and the vertex C₁. What is the section?
stages.solutionSteps: 1. MN ∥ D₁C₁ and equal: a parallelogram. 2. MN ⊥ NC₁: a rectangle.
stages.solutionStepsEnglish: 1. MN ∥ D₁C₁ and equal: a parallelogram. 2. MN ⊥ NC₁: a rectangle.
stages.customInstructions: Accept rectangle; the section is MNC₁D₁.

stages.headline: At most how many sides can a section of a tetrahedron have?
stages.headlineEnglish: At most how many sides can a section of a tetrahedron have?
stages.problemText: At most how many sides can a section of a tetrahedron have?
stages.solutionSteps: 1. Each side lies in a face, and there are 4 faces.
stages.solutionStepsEnglish: 1. Each side lies in a face, and there are 4 faces.
